overview_description: List, create, read, update and delete the sales reps set up in your Exsited organisation settings.
intro: Sales reps are the people you can name as the sales rep on an account or order. This area lists, creates, reads, updates and deletes them under settings. It has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **Creating a sales rep fails on the current instance.** `POST /settings/sales_reps` returns `400` with `validation_error` and no field named for every valid body tried, so the update and delete calls have no new rep to work on.
**Bodies sit under `sales_rep`.** A new rep takes `first_name`, `last_name` and `email_address`.
**`status` is `active` or `inactive`.** Send it in an update to enable or disable a rep.
**A sales rep id starts with `sr_`.** Shipping rules use the same `sr_` prefix, so check which kind of record an id names.
**The listing pages by cursor.** Send `limit`, then pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` while `pagination.has_more` is `true`.

endpoints.title: List sales reps
endpoints.summary: Lists the sales reps set up in your organisation, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: The records are under `data`, and `pagination` holds the cursor for the next page. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` to sort in descending order.

200.description: One page of sales reps, under `data`.

endpoints.title: Create a sales rep
endpoints.summary: Creates a sales rep from a first name, last name and email address.
endpoints.description: Send the new rep under `sales_rep`. On the current instance this call returns `400` with `validation_error` and no field named, for every valid body tried.

400.description: `validation_error` with no field named, returned for every valid body tried.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a sales rep
endpoints.description: Pass the rep's `id`, which starts with `sr_`. The response holds the rep's name, email address and `status`.

parameters.name: sales_rep_id
parameters.description: The sales rep's `id`, which starts with `sr_`.

endpoints.title: Delete a sales rep
endpoints.summary: Deletes a sales rep and returns no content.
endpoints.description: Pass the rep's `id`. A successful delete returns `204` with an empty body.

parameters.name: sales_rep_id
parameters.description: The sales rep's `id`, which starts with `sr_`.

204.description: The sales rep is deleted. The body is empty.

endpoints.title: Update a sales rep
endpoints.summary: Changes a sales rep's details, or enables or disables the rep.
endpoints.description: Send only the fields to change under `sales_rep`. Set `status` to `active` or `inactive` to enable or disable the rep.

parameters.name: sales_rep_id
parameters.description: The sales rep's `id`, which starts with `sr_`.

limit.description: The page size the API applied.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. `false` ends the listing even when `next_cursor` is present.

next_cursor.description: Send as `cursor` to fetch the next page.
